g.text: What PhysMAP adds to input-based OOD detection

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Seven published datasets, at the default setting (percentile 99). Counts are rows of each dataset: rows are not independent cases,

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: and the datasets are not pooled. Whether a count shows a failure that deployment created depends on the home baseline.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781

g.text: Source: data/benchmarks/v0_4_1/matrix_full_seven.json (per vehicle, at the reference percentile); the same counts print in `physmap benchmark report`; data: docs/talk/figures/data/bench_3_what_physmap_adds.csv
